plan: Drive: from Heffley Creek, about 138 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5, Lloyd Rd, Otter Creek FSR.
Park: 51.66484, -119.45488, pull off on Otter Creek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 40 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
